objective: Add real ED original-result capture and completed-replication recovery interfaces; test bounded backpressure and fault propagation through a real filesystem fixture adapter. No production codec or export migration.
interface_contract: Synchronous acknowledged bounded batches of original PatientResult rows; no hidden sink queue. Results emit after scheduler execution, not event streaming. Existing summary/model memory is retained. Per-worker pending batch <= row/encoded-byte cap plus at most one bounded lookahead row; W workers multiply this bound. Encode through bounded Write, reject oversized row. PartStore has no default codec; production orchestrator independently validates actual read bytes hashes, decoded identity, contiguous sequences and row counts before completed-replication resume. Incomplete-replication/orphan parts reject; no midreplication resume claim. Filesystem fixture uses real files/faults, not production durability qualification. Actual codec framing determines splitting. Patient ID bytes have a separate positive cap. Model/summary allocations, accumulated checkpoint metadata and codec encode/decode scratch require separate memory qualification; encoded bytes do not bound decompression memory.
steps: Freeze reviewed interface/ownership scope and claim.

Run actual filesystem/latch tests and legacy invocation red tests; record results independently.
